name: make
title: Makefile targets
description: The targets of every Makefile under your project folders. Enter runs one in a terminal (or in the background, with a toast).
author: pal

settings.label: Project folders
settings.description: Folders scanned two levels deep for a Makefile, makefile or GNUmakefile. ~ is expanded.

settings.label: Run in
settings.description: Where Run puts make. A terminal keeps its window open until you press Enter; background runs it unseen and toasts the exit status (the output opens in the panel when it failed; a run past 8 s is left to finish on its own). On Linux the terminal is $TERMINAL, else kitty, foot, alacritty, xterm.

store.tagline: Every Makefile target under your projects, one Enter from running.
features: Every target of every Makefile two levels under the `projects` folders, one section per project; `pal test` finds a project's target from the root
Descriptions from `## text` on the rule line or the comment above it, shown after the folder in the subtitle
`enter` opens a terminal in the project folder running `make <target>`; the window waits for Enter so a quick target's output stays readable
`terminal = "background"` runs it unseen: a toast with the exit status and the last line, the whole output in the panel when it failed
The detail pane shows the recipe; `cmd+l` opens the whole Makefile in the panel, `cmd+c` copies `make -C <dir> <target>`
